0022600112.text: The Lakers (2-0) head to Utah for their third game of the season, sitting first in the Pacific and first in the West, while the Jazz (1-1) are 8th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 1 game back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Lakers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 131-107 in Los Angeles on April 12. Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain), while Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise).
